versions.changelog:
Register index.html under the same key every other plugin uses

The Watch Party button was still missing with the transformation visibly
registered in the log:

  Received transformation registration for '(^|/)index\.html$' with ID
  '0f2fd0fd-...'

alongside Media Bar, Custom Tabs and Plugin Pages, each of which registers
the literal 'index.html'. That difference is the whole bug.

File Transformation keys its pipelines by the registration string and
RunTransformation selects exactly ONE pipeline per file:

  if (m_fileTransformations.ContainsKey(path))   // exact key wins
      pipeline = m_fileTransformations[path];
  else { /* regex keys, only when no exact key matched */ }

So the regex branch is dead code whenever any plugin has registered the
literal 'index.html'. Ours lived in its own pipeline under a different key,
was never selected, and never ran — while still logging a healthy-looking
registration line.

Register the literal 'index.html' so we join the shared pipeline and all
the injections compose, which is what the ecosystem convention is actually
for.

The previous pattern was not wrong in isolation: registered alone it is
found by the regex fallback and works. It only fails once another plugin
claims the exact key, which is why it survived review and broke on a real
server. The tests now model File Transformation's dispatch — key
normalisation, both gates, single-pipeline selection — instead of testing
our pattern as a bare regex, which was the abstraction that hid this. The
co-existence case fails against the old pattern; the standalone case still
passes, reproducing the exact conditions under which this shipped.
